posts.author: rohanpaul_ai
posts.text: A model's context window does not have to be an agent's workspace limit. KVMEM makes million-token agent memory practical by paging old KV state, cutting recall cost while beating compaction on task success. On DeepSWE with Qwen3.8-27B, Pass@1 rose from 43.8% to 48.4% versus compaction-only. Across controlled benchmarks, recovery was 11.4-53.8x faster than Compact+RAG. On a laptop with a 24 GB RTX 5090 GPU, KVMEM supported a 1M-token workspace at about 50 tokens/s.
